items.title: 2026 Federal Budget officially tabled — CGT and negative gearing changes confirmed
items.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers has officially tabled the 2026 Federal Budget. The 50% CGT discount is abolished from 1 July 2027, replaced by CPI indexation plus a hard 30% minimum tax floor on net capital gains.

items.title: New builds remain fully exempt — developer lobby claims budget favours supply
items.summary: Newly constructed residential properties are exempt from both the negative gearing and CGT changes. Property developer lobbies say this is a deliberate policy to encourage housing supply.

items.title: Bills introduced in Parliament for CGT and negative gearing reforms
items.summary: Two bills have been introduced to implement the CGT discount changes and negative gearing modifications. The legislation is scheduled for debate next week.

items.title: Division 296 CGT relief for SMSF restructuring
items.summary: Treasury has released draft legislation for the Division 296 $3m super balance tax, including CGT relief provisions that allow SMSFs to reset the cost base of assets when restructuring to comply with the new rules. This relief prevents unintended tax consequences from forced realisation of assets during restructuring.
